answer.says: Ramesh, the heat will rise. I shall remain here to rest my eyes and mind. Do not disturb me unless the house is on fire or the Director himself arrives.
answer.thought: The morning walk is finished, and the grey sky remains a stubborn refusal of the sun. I shall sit in the shade and let the mind digest the morning's observations before the heat becomes a tyrant. The dialectic of the Indian spirit requires a cool head, not a sweating brow.
